test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The little boy said, “My cat can climb the tree.”

options.text: The little boy said that his cat climbed the tree.
The little boy said that his cat had climbed the tree.
The little boy said that his cat could climb the tree.
The little boy said that his cat can climb the tree.

solution:
"The correct answer is **'Option 3'**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The sentence "The little boy said, “My cat can climb the tree.”" is in direct speech.
 
• In indirect speech, we do not use quotation marks and the verb tense usually shifts back (here from "can" to "could").
 
• Among the given options, option 3 "The little boy said that his cat could climb the tree." correctly applies these rules to convert the direct speech into indirect speech.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 

 
• Option 1: "The little boy said that his cat climbed the tree." This changes the meaning by stating that the action has already occurred.
 
• Option 2: "The little boy said that his cat had climbed the tree." This also implies completed action, which is not the original meaning.
 
• Option 4: "The little boy said that his cat can climb the tree." This option doesn't shift verb tense, as required when converting to indirect speech.
